items.detail: The **Nasdaq** jumped **1.05%** to 26,702.86 Wednesday, leading the S&P 500 up 0.58% to a 7,757.17 close as tech took back the lead from value stocks.
items.why: Strong results from SpaceX and Super Micro brought back appetite for AI stocks, outweighing Netflix's slide.

items.detail: **Tesla** fell about **3%** after hours even though its quarterly results beat forecasts, with $28.05 billion in revenue, while Meta beat estimates and raised its outlook.
items.why: Investors are questioning big AI spending, and Meta's plan to issue non-voting shares drew fresh doubts.

items.detail: With the **Fed** meeting on October 28, markets expect rates to stay on hold but are still pricing in a **December hike**.
items.why: Brent pushing back above $110 has revived inflation worries and kept bets on tighter Fed policy alive.

items.detail: South Korea's **Kospi** fell **2.24%** to 5,607.28 Thursday, giving back part of Wednesday's 3.3% rally as most Asian markets slipped.
items.why: Doubts about AI spending after Meta's results and tension in the Gulf quickly wiped out the boost from tech earnings.

items.detail: The **Nifty** fell back below 23,000 to **22,811.35** Wednesday, down 0.34%, its second losing session in a row, as India VIX jumped about 6%.
items.why: Brent above $110 and weak bank stocks outweighed a sharp rally in IT shares, and midcaps did worse.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** gained just **0.24%** to 2,783.29 Wednesday, after Tuesday's best day since August, as money moved back toward big tech.
items.why: With the 10-year yield stuck near 5.11%, investors went back to AI megacaps instead of rate-sensitive small firms.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** held near **$83,350** Wednesday, and its volatility dropped close to its lowest level of 2026.
items.why: Traders are waiting on next week's Fed decision and the US midterms before making big bets.

items.detail: **Ether** briefly climbed back above **$2,500** Wednesday for the first time in over a week, before easing to around $2,490.
items.why: The tech-stock rally lifted ETH, though October outflows from Ether ETFs near $1.08 billion keep holding it back.

items.detail: **Solana** traded near **$106** after its Alpenglow upgrade went live Wednesday, cutting transaction finality to about 150 milliseconds.
items.why: Ongoing outflows from US Solana funds and a large corporate SOL sale have so far blunted any lift from the upgrade.

items.detail: **Gold** ended a four-day losing streak, with spot up 0.3% to about **$4,138** Wednesday, before slipping to around $4,127 Thursday.
items.why: A second straight dip in the 10-year yield helped, but Brent above $110 is keeping Fed hike bets alive.

crossCuttingTheme: Brent back above $110 is keeping US yields near 5.1% and December Fed hike bets alive, which is weighing on India, gold and small caps while AI earnings alone decide whether tech rallies.
